why: AcpmuxServerPeer.StrictVerdicts.shared: a process-wide memo of the strict team-signature check, so AcpmuxEnvironment.resolve's synchronous main-thread callers stop re-reading the whole acpmux binary (1.7-2.1 s hangs, nightly hang report 2026-11-05). resolve and executableSignedByAppTeam are static, called from about 15 sites with no instance to hold a cache. The memo has no behaviour of its own: a pure function of a file's contents keyed by (team, resolved path), guarded by the file's stat identity (dev, inode, size, mtime, ctime), passing verdicts only, in memory only, one entry per (team, path). Injection seam: executableSignedByAppTeam(_:team:verdicts:), which tests use with a private instance and clock.
